sector_model: E-commerce cross-border enablement platform (foreign private issuer, US GAAP, 20-F and 6-K): value on GMV growth, revenue and adjusted EBITDA, FCF with working capital and merchant funds flows, acquisition effects, SBC and tax effects; GAAP NI distorted by deferred tax asset recognition.
thesis: Global-e (Nasdaq: GLBE). Q3 2026 release (6-K Ex 99.1 filed 2026-11-18, same day) read in full for the figures cited: GMV 2,041.6M (+35%), revenue 314.1M (+42%; service fees 134.0M, fulfillment 180.1M), GAAP operating profit 32.1M (17.1M a year earlier), adjusted EBITDA 63.7M (20.3% margin), GAAP net profit 81.1M helped by a 50.9M tax benefit (49.0M deferred tax). FY26 guide raised: revenue 1,329M to 1,353M (from 1,305M to 1,355M), adjusted EBITDA 290M to 300M, GMV 8,957M to 9,117M; Q4 revenue 464M to 488M vs 336.7M a year earlier implied (+38% to +45%). 9M revenue 865.2M vs 625.5M. 9M26 OCF 69.2M vs 67.2M; Q3 FCF 66.4M. Acquisition (Passport) paid 178.8M net in Q3; goodwill rose from 375.4M to 640.3M and intangibles from 52.4M to 201.1M. Buybacks 53.4M in Q3, 180.4M in 9M26, 447M authorization left. Price: close 38.03 on 2026-11-18 x about 166.0M Q3 weighted basic shares (approximation) = about 6,313M; cash, short term deposits and marketable securities 346.6M, no debt line, EV about 5,966M = 5.0x TTM revenue 1,201.8M and about 20x the FY26 adjusted EBITDA guide midpoint 295M. TTM OCF 285.7M less PP&E 2.9M = FCF 282.9M (4.5% of market cap; 3.8% after TTM SBC 45.7M). TTM GAAP NI 221.6M (28.5x) is inflated by the tax benefit. The market may be pricing slowing organic growth and platform dependence; the differing evidence is accelerating GMV, rising guidance and a falling share count. Stock fell 4.5% on 11-18 despite the raise (cause not verified).
counterthesis: Reported growth includes an acquisition (Passport; organic split not read). 9M OCF was only 69.2M against 9M adjusted EBITDA 176.3M, so cash conversion in 2026 depends on a strong Q4 and on merchant fund timing; TTM FCF leans on Q4 2025. GAAP profit relies on a 50.9M tax benefit. Non-GAAP gross margin fell to 44.8% from 46.3% and G&A rose 85%. Revenue depends on Shopify Managed Markets and a few large merchants (concentration unread); fulfillment revenue (57% of total) is lower margin pass through. Adjusted EBITDA excludes SBC, acquisition amortization and contingent consideration. Global tariffs, de minimis changes and consumer demand can cut GMV.
invalidation: Invalidated if GMV growth falls below about 20%, Q4 revenue lands below the 464M guide low end, adjusted EBITDA margin falls under 18%, full year OCF fails to reach about 250M, or a major merchant or Shopify arrangement is lost.
